    How to use the cards
    • White Rose vocabulary — every maths block carries the official words from the Primary maths vocabulary progression (Sept 2025). They are listed first, so they are what prints by default; the blue badge shows how many a block introduces.
    • Front-loading — hand out the word cards before the unit starts. Children sort them into know it / heard it / new, then sort again at the end.
    • Match-up — print the match-up set and pair each word with its meaning, or play pelmanism face down.
    • Reasoning sorts — print a sort's heading cards and let groups place the words. Cards that fit two headings are the best discussion.
    • Maths pictures — match a representation to the calculation, then find two pictures showing the same thing a different way.
    • Word association — draw two cards and explain how they connect to the central idea.
